front_blocks.md: Define **renewable energy**.

back_blocks.md: **Renewable energy** sources are **infinite** and will **not run out**, e.g. hydroelectric, wave/tidal, wind, solar, geothermal and biomass.

This is true for most, but **biomass/waste** produces greenhouse gases; greenhouse gases may also be emitted in the **production, construction and transport** of equipment.
